sloka: त्रातुमर्हसि वीर त्वं पातालादिव कौशिकीम् ।ततो वस्त्रगतं मुक्त्वा दिव्यं चूडामणिं शुभम् ।प्रदेयो राघवायेति सीता हनुमते ददौ ।। ५.३८.६९।।।।
transliteration: trātumarhasi vīra tvaṁ pātālādiva kauśikīm ।tato vastragataṁ muktvā divyaṁ cūḍāmaṇiṁ śubham ।pradeyo rāghavāyeti sītā hanumate dadau ।। 5.38.69।।।।

translations.english: Then Sita took out the exquisite and auspicious Chudamani worn on the head, untied from her clothes and gave it to Hanuman to be presented to Rama.
